Laura / Monica — forwarding AlpenData's onboarding packet. They are a Swiss-registered reseller/consultancy and asked for PO activation and guidance on VAT treatment (they prefer CHF invoices without Swiss VAT and can include reverse-charge language).

Can procurement/AP confirm:
- required vendor master fields for CH entities (we have UID CHE-123.456.789)
- whether Redwood should treat these invoices as VAT-exempt/export services or apply any Swiss VAT withholding rules
- PO numbering to appear on invoices and any PO invoice-format requirements (we typically require PO#, line-level GL mapping, tax breakdown when applicable)
- whether we can set vendor currency to CHF and route payments via SWIFT (attachments include bank spec)

Proposed immediate action: procurement to create vendor record and issue a 1-time PO for the pilot once AP confirms tax mapping.

Thanks — Marcus
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

(On a related note: if we treat as reverse-charge, we need a tax code in the GL system to avoid us paying VAT. If not, AP will need to handle VAT on the invoice.)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor onboarding docs — AlpenData AG (CH)

Thanks for the packet, Marcus — and hi Nora.

Quick summary from procurement side: we can create a vendor master record with currency set to CHF and route payments by SWIFT. Before PO activation AP needs to confirm the VAT handling so bookkeeping gets the correct tax code. A few clarifying requests:

1) Nora — please confirm whether AlpenData's services for Redwood are delivered to Redwood (US entity) or directly to Redwood's EU customers. Place-of-supply determines Swiss VAT treatment.

2) Please confirm whether AlpenData expects Redwood to apply reverse-charge wording on the invoice ("reverse charge — customer liable for VAT"). If you want us to accept invoices without Swiss VAT we will need your UID and an explicit statement about place-of-supply.

3) Sample invoice: can you attach a draft invoice showing UID, PO placeholder, and line-level descriptions? AP prefers explicit tax lines (taxable amount, VAT rate, VAT amount) even if VAT = 0.

4) Withholding: for Switzerland we do not generally withhold VAT on service invoices; withholding tax could apply to certain royalties/technical services, but that is rare for the consulting work described. If AlpenData anticipates royalties, flag it.

Once we have the sample invoice and confirmation on place-of-supply/reverse-charge, procurement will:
- validate attachments and set vendor master (expected 1 business day)
- issue a PO for the pilot (PO# will be in format REDW-CH-YYYY-####)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf)

From: Nora Huber <nora.huber@alpendata.ch>

Hi Laura / Marcus / Monica,

Thanks for the quick response. Answers below and attached a sample invoice.

1) Place of supply: AlpenData will be providing remote analytics services to Redwood's corporate account (Redwood Inference, US entity). We are not billing end customers directly.

2) VAT treatment: AlpenData is VAT-registered (UID CHE-123.456.789). For services provided to a foreign corporate customer (Redwood US) we generally issue invoices without Swiss VAT and indicate the transaction is outside Swiss VAT scope — however, we can also include the note "VAT reverse charge — customer liable" if that helps Redwood's accounting.

3) Sample invoice attached: sample_invoice_chf.pdf — it shows PO placeholder, UID, line-level descriptions, amounts in CHF and a VAT line showing 0.00 with the note about reverse charge.

4) Withholding: there are no royalties; this is consultancy / services. No withholding expected on our side.

Bank details remain the same (bank_details_chf.xlsx). If you send the PO number we will ensure the final invoice includes it.

Attachments: sample_invoice_chf.pdf

Best regards,
Nora Huber
